name: Melo
description: Warm coral and paper tones, arched photography and open product cards with editable details and shopping guidance.
previewLabel: Design imagery is included and editable. Start with an empty product card and connect your products before publishing or exporting code.

optionalSections.melo-unbox: Actual details and prices of up to two connected products; hidden for empty drafts
optionalSections.project-picker: Availability filters appear when connected products include available and sold-out items

demoContent: Fictional catalog, kit contents, specifications and promises stay in preview/. Applied pages use merchant products and normal Ezkart checkout.
